title: Describe a project to CMake

solution.CMakeLists.txt:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(Shapes LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

add_library(shapes shapes.cpp)

add_executable(app main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(app PRIVATE shapes)

hints: Each line is a command with its arguments in brackets, separated by spaces. Order matters in one place: a target has to be defined (`add_library`, `add_executable`) before `target_link_libraries` can mention it.
